reason: v9's A Responses API outputs had an extra closing brace; the second also duplicated an identical region_m key. A bounded, opt-in syntax repair accepts only one extra closing brace and/or equal-valued duplicate keys. Raw bytes and repaired hashes are journaled; conflicting duplicates, unknown syntax faults, schema errors and semantic faults still fail. The first v9 A response is locally proven parseable and classifiable under this rule. Input, provider, D/E guidance and budgets match v9.
scope: One 0.1.0 fixed A-F single-storey building case, not general structured-output reliability.
sample_policy: One run. All started calls count; v1-v9 records are immutable. Any further real retry requires another pre-registered batch.

success.machine: result.json succeeds, source geometry validates, WIR package round-trips, Unity GLB and Minecraft schematic are produced from the same revision, and exact offline replay reproduces package and target hashes.
success.human: Inspect one single-storey timber house, connected street-facing entrance and reachable interior. Target import and actual walking remain separate evidence levels.
success.report: Record calls, repaired responses, failures, elapsed time and provider usage; one pass is not reliability proof.

cases.prompt: 在一块32米见方的平坦区域内，沿一条可步行的街道建造一栋单层木屋。木屋需要一个面向街道的入口和一间能够从街道进入的室内房间。
